capabilities: Extract and confirm knowledge points from a notes folder organized as a course
Generate practice questions (single choice, multiple choice, true/false, short answer) from your material
Plan study sessions around available time, due reviews, and learning gaps
Grade answers locally or via the model and schedule independent re-review a day or more apart
Run unit assessments with feedback held until submission, including reassessment and question invalidation
extras: Pre-release (0.9.4) not yet published in the community directory; manual installation required. Stores the API key unencrypted in config.json, which the README says to exclude from sync and Git. Study progress lives in data.json, so cross-device sync of progress depends on the user's sync service, with no conflict merging.
problem: Obsidian stores study material but offers no way to practice it, get feedback on answers, or schedule reviews over time.

relations.evidence: Use an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint or the native Ollama API.
Ollama requires an already running, reachable service and an installed model.

summary: AI study coach that turns course notes into confirmed knowledge points, generated practice questions, planned sessions, and spaced review.
